## Summary
Provide a brief overview of the change along with the context.

## Validation
- [ ] I have reviewed the changes.
- [ ] Relevant validation has been performed.
- [ ] Required checks or commands are documented.

## Type of change
- [ ] break: Breaking change — major version bump (e.g., renaming required variables, removing resources, changing output names in a backward-incompatible way)
- [ ] feat: New feature or enhancement — minor version bump (e.g., adding a new module, adding optional inputs, introducing new resources without breaking existing usage)
- [ ] fix: Bug fix — patch version bump (e.g., correcting invalid Terraform logic, fixing a misconfigured resource, repairing broken outputs)
- [ ] refactor: Internal code cleanup or structural improvement — no version bump (e.g., renaming variables, reorganizing files, simplifying logic without behavior change)
- [ ] chore: Tooling, config, or maintenance update — no version bump (e.g., .gitignore, formatting, pre-commit config, non-functional repo maintenance)
- [ ] docs: Documentation-only change — no version bump (e.g., README, examples, comments, usage docs)
- [ ] ci: CI/CD workflow change — no version bump (e.g., GitHub Actions, pipeline configuration)
- [ ] build: Build or dependency change — usually no version bump unless release behavior changes (e.g., updating `pom.xml`, `Makefile`, `Dockerfile`, or other build/dependency configuration files)
